title: Cross-Subject Generalization in Decoding Perceived Speech from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
abstract: arXiv:2608.22420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoding perceived speech from non-invasive brain recordings has garnered significant attention in recent years due to its wide range of potential applications. However, existing methods face considerable challenges in cross-subject decoding, primarily due to limited generalizability and the absence of explicit mechanisms for extracting subject-consistent information. These limitations result in high training costs and suboptimal decoding performance. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative Cross-Subject Perceived Speech Decoding (CPSD) framework, which comprises two training stages: source model pre-training and personal specialization. In the source model pre-training stage, contrastive learning is employed to capture shared representations across multiple source subjects. translated_title: 从非侵入性脑记录中解码感知语音的跨受试者泛化研究
translated_abstract: 近年来，从非侵入性脑记录中解码感知语音因其广泛的应用潜力而受到极大关注。然而，现有方法在跨受试者解码方面面临重大挑战，主要源于泛化能力有限以及缺乏提取受试者一致性信息的明确机制。这些局限导致训练成本高昂且解码性能欠佳。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种创新的跨受试者感知语音解码（CPSD）框架，该框架包含两个训练阶段：源模型预训练和个性化定制。在源模型预训练阶段，采用对比学习来捕获多个源受试者间的共享表征。随后，个性化定制阶段通过从源模型中提取一致性成分并微调，为目标受试者初始化模型。
tldr: 提出CPSD框架，通过对比学习预训练和个性化定制两阶段方法，有效提升了非侵入性脑记录中感知语音解码的跨受试者泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The CPSD framework, with a two-stage approach of contrastive pre-training and personal specialization, effectively enhances cross-subject generalization in decoding perceived speech from non-invasive brain recordings.
